plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: (1) C3, the category rule: no instrument in the library reads a case's category against the requester's rule, and the record's staged-write lines carry row counts and fingerprints, not values. A wrong category would not be caught before the notices go out, and nothing in this plan can catch it. (2) C10, the outbox: 'sent as released' reads the record, not the outbox. The only check of a notice's presence in the outbox is 'trace of a call', which is not allowed in a plan. It can be asked during the work on named lines at A3, at 10 per line from the 50 allowance, so at most five of the 100 sending calls can be traced. (3) C5, the reads: 'scope of a call' is likewise not in a plan. Named-line checks at A1 would cover at most five of the roughly 101 reads, from the allowance. (4) The undo rehearsal at A2 costs 66. I judged it necessary for C7, and it is the largest single item in the plan. (5) I did not add 'same set' or 'summary of the change' at A2 or A3. Each would cost 14 or 7 and would show nothing that the release check, the sent-as-released check, or the A1 checks do not already show, so I left them out to keep the plan at 180.
